entities.summary: Amenukal is a title for the highest Tuareg traditional chiefs; he is the head of an "ettebel" and chosen from among the few relatives of the deceased amenokal. The term amenokal means "supreme chief, king, emperor". · European observers have proposed several words to describe the scope of an amenokal's command (ettebel): confederation, political grouping, or "drum groups".
